## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 9, 2026 - Aug 29, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Anissa Garcia_, Aug 29, 2026, 1/5: "I love this app. I believe there is a bug. I am unable to share habits with others and consistently get “Failed to modify some records” every time. The person I am trying to share habits with also gets the same notification. Please fix! 🫶🏼"
            2. _sianadele_, Aug 17, 2026, 1/5: "Downloaded this because I’ve seen so many people talking about it. It started off well but not every time I open the app it freezes and I can’t click anything!"
            3. _Rxxhxm_, Jun 9, 2026, 1/5: "I am a long term user. I have been using it everyday since January 2021. I have even bought the premium version of the app. This app has really helped me with my life. I highly recommend this app to anyone wanting a track their habits. However, I would not recommend this app to use long-term as if you want to track your progress, you can’t as I have explained below. I initially reviewed and rated it 5*. The reason why I am rating it 1* is because, as time went by, the habit tracking became more and more broken, unstable, unusable meaning that if you go on any specific habit, then you scroll down to ‘trending’ or ‘comparison’ between weeks, months and years. It doesn’t show last weeks or this weeks / last month or this month / last year or this years progress. Instead, it’s just a blank black screen. This has been like this for 6-9 months and I thought that I would give the developers the opportunities to fix this issue however they did not fix the issue but instead of pushing out new features and updates rather than fixing the original issue. This is unfair for the people who has paid for the premium service, but isn’t getting the basic features of the app."
<!--/ir-theme-->
